signing.windows: Unsigned; publisher signing has not been configured
signing.macos: Ad hoc build signature; no Developer ID signing or notarization
signing.linux: Archive SHA-256 checksums; no detached publisher signature

release_features: Add --render-js auto, the recommended mode for unknown pages: acquire statically and run JavaScript only on a JavaScript shell page; bare --render-js still means always. Pages that need browser APIs outside the bounded engine, such as crates.io, refuse at javascript_required.

Refuse captcha, bot challenge, login and JavaScript shell pages with a plain reason at stage challenge or javascript_required, instead of near-empty successes. Challenges are named, such as cloudflare, datadome or qrator, never solved.
Report http_status, redirect_count, challenge, charset, charset_source and render_js in URL receipts; brewdoc.receipt/2 changes only by adding keys.
Add --no-links for HTML: keep link text, omit destinations and disclose it in the receipt.
Decode mislabelled HTML charsets and undeclared Latin or Cyrillic HTML by fallback instead of refusing, disclosed as charset_fallback in local receipts.
Write links inside code and around images as standard Markdown links instead of [Link target] records; local HTML Markdown changes for these links.
release_fixes: Keep the HTTP status and the redirect reason in URL refusals instead of a generic stage message.
Fall back to the acquired HTML when the JavaScript heap runs out, the DOM snapshot check fails or a page runs more than 200 timer callbacks, instead of refusing.
Start no script or module fetch after the JavaScript soft window, so script-heavy pages stop sooner.
Run scripts served or typed with any WHATWG JavaScript MIME type, such as application/x-javascript.
Let a non-HTTP(S) sub-request fail alone and ignore a non-HTTP(S) base URL, instead of refusing the JavaScript capture.
Convert pages that create upper-case STYLE, TITLE or TEXTAREA elements during JavaScript capture.
Offer ALPN http/1.1 over HTTPS, so WordPress.com sites that answered 403 to brewdoc, such as acloserlisten.com, now load.

features: Offline PDF, DOCX, PPTX, workbook and static HTML conversion
EPUB 2/3 conversion with Unicode and publication navigation
Explicit URL acquisition and optional isolated JavaScript capture
